title: Protected blog merge did not trigger original immediate proof reconciliation
root_cause: Canonical Powerhouse daily blog workflow's on.push.paths did not include blog/** output. Original protected blog PR #5718 could merge and deploy Netlify READY while the only original reconcile step remained scheduled hourly, leaving canonical Supabase obligation APPROVED without HTTP/consumer ACK during the delay.
impact: Nov 13 original blog PR #5718 merged de138afbd5caa5738b1d4b881e18bdc29ed2bdc7 and Netlify production deploy 6af6c751e4198b40cb648397 READY at 2026-11-13T08:18:01.816Z, yet at last DB read blog status APPROVED, live_proven_at and public_http_status NULL. This is handoff latency; no evidence the public page failed or conversion outcomes changed.
fix: Add blog/** to on.push.paths of ONE existing hourly blog workflow, preserve original 11 * * * * schedule and same concurrency, existing signed proof reconciler, source PR merge and no-duplicate gates; update original agent/skill, regression, machine/human logs.
prevention_rule: For same-day protected blog merge, the original owner should wake on blog output changes and separately prove actual rendered canonical article HTTP200, exact production deploy SHA and original DB consumer receipt; never equate CI/Netlify READY with a published and learned article.
owner: Existing Powerhouse daily blog from Supabase workflow / agent-social-delivery-recovery, original P0 #4198
evidence: GitHub #5718 protected merged main de138afbd5caa5738b1d4b881e18bdc29ed2bdc7; exact-head Required 43391048764 and CodeQL 43391048836 succeeded.
Native Netlify production deploy 6af6c751e4198b40cb648397 READY published at 2026-11-13T08:18:01.816Z exact SHA.
Original content_publication_obligations blog 2026-11-13 was still APPROVED, evidence.public_http_status null, evidence.netlify_deploy_id null on observed readback.
Existing on.push.paths matched workflow and Supabase source paths only, no blog/**; original hourly 11 * * * * job still runs original script.
status_boundary: Candidate until protected Required/CodeQL merge, independent postmerge workflow activation and public HTML+terminal Supabase readback; do not claim LIVE_PROVEN or LEARNED from just the new trigger.
